key_insight: Delta-VQE can detect phase transitions with shallow circuits, but it only finds the true critical point when the variational ansätze are physically matched to the competing phases.
engineering_relevance: This makes variational quantum algorithms a resource-efficient tool for phase-diagram probing, while emphasizing that ansatz design is as important as circuit depth.
method: Compare variational energies optimized from reference states in different phases.
Use shallow VQE circuits to contrast candidate phases and locate sharp energy crossings.
Test the approach on the 1D transverse-field Ising model with three-spin cluster interaction.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that dual ansätze consistently identify self-dual points instead of the true criticality, whereas tailored ansätze recover the genuine Ising critical point with only minor finite-size effects.
watch_item: If the ansatz is not representative of the actual phases, Delta-VQE may return a misleading transition point rather than the true criticality.
paper_title: Detecting quantum phase transitions via shallow variational quantum circuits
